content: .{@-प्रवचनीयः@} a term for certain prepositions, particles, or adverbs when they are not connected with verbs and govern a noun in some case; literally, the term means, ‘Concerned with the setting forth of an action’. According to Indian grammarians it means ‘that which spoke of an action (क्रियां प्रोक्तवन्तः)’ {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} आ in आ मुक्तेः संसारः is a कर्मप्रवचनीय; so अनु in जपमनु प्रावर्षत् <ab>&c.</ab>; कर्म प्रोक्तवन्तः कर्मप्रवचनीया इति <ls>Mbh.</ls> on <ls>P. I. 4. 83</ls>. <ab>cf.</ab> उपसर्ग, गति and निपात also.
